description: This file defines a custom Request class extending Symfony's HttpRequest, with overridden get method for deprecation handling and a static method to create request objects from PHP globals, tailored for the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Custom HTTP Request class extending Symfony's Request, adding deprecated method handling and special behavior for authorization headers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overrides the parent get method to include a deprecation warning when called in certain development modes and call stack contexts.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates an instance of Request from PHP globals, with extra handling to set the Authorization header if missing.
